predictions: The bad news is that I tied for my worst record so far last week. The good news is that bad week was still 19-8! Woowoo. That brings me to 79-29 (73.1% correct) for the season, which is pretty stout. And it's honestly even better than that in most divisions, as I'm still being weighed down by my F division albatross (4-8 so far, and flippin' 0-4 in matches involving That's What She Said… that is tough to do...).

Match of the week: (A Div.) Jonesing for Mugs @ Appetite for Destruction. A's top three will decide league supremacy across six head-to-head battles in weeks 5-7 and 12-14. And here we go with round 1 of the 6!! Will Jonesing finally unveil one… or two… or all three of their as-yet missing players? Will Appetite have only one absence themselves, or two? So many questions! Appetite, 14-10?

Match #2: (E Div.) What's the Point? @ Shooting Blanks. Only 5 of 8 divisions can still offer battles of unbeatens, and this week brings us the lead duo in E (didn't I read back in week 1 that this was E's top pair? :o). This one is going to the last 501… It's the Blanks, 13-11.

Match #3: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ SofaKings. Bright Side's only loss so far is to the other undefeated H team, so if they can't take out Sofa tonight, the gap in H becomes two matches. But if they do win, the H race is on and poppin'. Alas, this is more Sofa time, 14-10.

Match #4: (G Div.) Flight Club @ Rippin Darts. After a week 1 loss, Flight Club has only posted narrow wins over two of G's bottom three. But the fact remains that they are in 3rd, within one loss of G's two undefeated leaders. At least until Rippin takes this, that is. 16-8.

Match #5: (D Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Point & Rally. What a weird and zig-zag-y season for McGavin so far, alternating weak losses with strong wins. Luckily for Rally, the McGavin cycle is on a down week this week. Plus, Rally is kinda badass on their own, sooo… P&R, 15-9.

Match #6: (G Div.) Aim-ing For Trouble @ Banging the Wire. Banging is 3-0 so far, but they've faced the bottom three teams and are only averaging 14 per week. I'm taking them here, but dang. Bang, 13-11.
Match #7: (A Div.) Son of a Beach @ Darty Minds. Do not under- estimate the importance here. Winner gets an early claim on being one of the four best teams in ALL OF RDL. Huge. Beach, 14-10.
Match #8: (F Div.) Down to F, Again @ Cheap Shots. Not sure if Death Throw will ever slip, but if they do, these matchups within the five 1-loss/2-loss teams could end up being big. Cheapies, 13-11.

Matches #9 & #10: (D Div.) Nine Lives @ Darty Sanchez; Double In Stumble Out @ The Bullies. It's only two matches from 2nd to 8th in D, so matchups with 2-2 and 1-3 teams could still affect the races at both ends of the division when it is all said and done. Let's go with a Niners bounceback, 13-11; and Stumble claims a 1001.
Match #11: (C Div.) Projectile Dysfunction @ Mulligans Mafia. Is this a match to determine who is the lead chase team? Or a match to determine who is fighting to avoid a fall to D? Yes. Mafia, 13-11.
Match #12: (G Div.) Sharky's Machine @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Could be a (very) early determinant in who ends up in a bottom- two spot (and facing a potential drop to H). We Throw It, 13-11?
